reports.title: The Middleby Corporation Reports Third Quarter Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: Management also provided the following expectations for the fourth quarter and full year 2026:

4th Qtr, 2026 | Full Year 2026
Net sales | $621-$635 M | $2.519-2.534 B
Organic Growth | 4.4% | 7.5%
Adjusted EBITDA(1) | $149-153 M | $589-593 M
Adjusted EPS(2) | $1.76-1.92 | $7.13-7.29
